# Dek SA (Satri Angthong Online)

> ระบบจัดการการเรียนและสารสนเทศ โรงเรียนสตรีอ่างทอง

This is the online learning and information management platform for Satri Angthong School.
Students can use this platform to:
- Check SGS grades
- View class schedules
- Access online courses and exams
- Read school announcements
- Download lesson summaries

## Contact Information
Satri Angthong School, Ang Thong, Thailand.

## Technical Details
This is a Single Page Application (SPA) built with React.
